facts.statement: Bagualosaurus lived approximately 230 million years ago during the Carnian stage of the Late Triassic period.
facts.quote: dating to around 230 million years ago, in the Carnian of the Late Triassic

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton was found in a rare position with the animal lying on its back and hindlimbs pulled up.
facts.quote: It was found on its back with the hindlimbs pulled up, a rare position for archosaurian fossils.

facts.statement: The species Bagualosaurus agudoensis was named and described in 2018 by Pretto, Langer, and Schultz.
facts.quote: In 2018, Pretto, Max Cardoso Langer and Schultz named and described the type species Bagualosaurus agudoensis.

facts.statement: Bagualosaurus measured approximately 2.25 meters in length.
facts.quote: measuring approximately 2.25 m in length

facts.statement: Based on its teeth, Bagualosaurus was mostly a herbivore.
facts.quote: that, based on its teeth, was mostly herbivore.

facts.statement: Most of Bagualosaurus's teeth were lance-shaped with rough surfaces.
facts.quote: La mayoría de los dientes tienen forma de lanza con dientes ásperos.

facts.statement: The skull was short, measuring less than two-thirds the length of the femur.
facts.quote: El cráneo es corto con menos de dos tercios de la longitud del fémur.

facts.statement: The teeth were slightly curved backward, lance-shaped, and had a constriction at the base.
facts.quote: Los dientes están ligeramente curvados hacia atrás. Son en forma de lanza con una constricción en la base.

facts.statement: The teeth had relatively large ridges perpendicular to the cutting edge, with three to five denticles per millimeter.
facts.quote: Hay pendientes relativamente grandes perpendiculares al filo de corte, pero no son demasiado gruesas con tres a cinco dentículos por milímetro lineal.

facts.statement: Bagualosaurus is classified as a dinosaur in the order Saurischia and suborder Sauropodomorpha.
facts.quote: superordo: Dinosauria ordo: Saurischia subordo: Sauropodomorpha

facts.statement: Bagualosaurus is a genus of sauropodomorph dinosaur.
facts.quote: Bagualosaurus is a genus of sauropodomorph dinosaur

facts.statement: Fossils of Bagualosaurus were found in the Candelária Sequence (Uppermost Santa Maria Formation) of Brazil.
facts.quote: from the Candelária Sequence (Uppermost Santa Maria Formation) of Brazil

facts.statement: A sauropodomorph skeleton was excavated in 2007 from a ravine near Agudo in Rio Grande do Sul.
facts.quote: In 2007, in a ravine at the outcrop of Janner, near Agudo in Rio Grande do Sul, a sauropodomorph skeleton was excavated.

facts.statement: The lower edge of the ilium bone over the hip joint is straight.
facts.quote: El borde inferior del hueso ilion sobre la articulación de la cadera es recto.

facts.statement: The tibia lacks a clear fibular crest.
facts.quote: La tibia no tiene una cresta fibular clara.

facts.statement: The second and third premaxillary teeth are the longest in the head, only slightly longer than the fourth and fifth maxillary teeth.
facts.quote: El segundo y tercer dientes premaxilares son los más largos de toda la cabeza, pero solo un poco más largos que los dientes superiores superiores, el cuarto y quinto.

facts.statement: Teeth are missing from the premaxillary and front dentary positions; it is unclear if this is a fixed morphology or accidental wear.
facts.quote: Los dientes faltan en los dientes premaxilares y los dientes dentales frontales; no está claro si esta es su morfología fija o si se han desgastado accidentalmente en esas posiciones.

facts.statement: The animal had approximately fifteen vertebrae that were amphicoelous, meaning hollow at both the front and back.
facts.quote: Las presumiblemente quince vértebras son anficoelicas, huecos en la parte delantera y trasera.

facts.statement: The preserved tail vertebrae lacked a hypophene-hypantrum complex.
facts.quote: Las vértebras de la cola conservadas no muestran un complejo hipofeno-hipanteno.

facts.statement: The skeleton was discovered in 2007 in the Janner rock formation, two kilometers from Agudo in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
facts.quote: En 2007, en la formación rocosa de Janner, a dos kilómetros de Agudo, en Rio Grande do Sul, se encontró el esqueleto de un dinosaurio en un barranco cerca de una piscina.

facts.statement: The species Bagualosaurus agudoensis was named and described in 2018 by Pretto, Max Cardoso Langer, and Schultz.
facts.quote: En 2018, Pretto, Max Cardoso Langer y Schultz nombraron y describieron el tipo de Bagualosaurus agudoensis.

facts.statement: The partial skeleton includes the lower part of a skull, lower jaws, nine dorsal vertebrae, three sacral vertebrae, two tail vertebrae, ribs, abdominal ribs, chevrons, both ilia, a right pubis, both femurs, both tibiae, both fibulae, and the left foot.
facts.quote: Se compone de un esqueleto parcial con calavera. La parte inferior de un cráneo, las mandíbulas inferiores, nueve vértebras dorsales, tres vértebras sacras, dos vértebras de la cola, costillas, costillas abdominales, chevrones, ambos iliones, un pubis derecho, ambos fémures, ambas tibias, ambos peronéos y el pie izquierdo.

facts.statement: The skeleton was remarkably articulated, a rarity for Triassic fossils, and likely disturbed by invertebrates shortly after the animal's death.
facts.quote: El esqueleto estaba bastante articulado, cosa rara en un esqueleto triásico y aparentemente fue comido por invertebrados poco después de la muerte del animal.

facts.statement: The skeleton was found lying on its back with both hind legs raised, an unusual posture for archosaur fossils.
facts.quote: El esqueleto se encontró tendido sobre la espalda, con ambas patas traseras levantadas, una actitud inusual hacia los fósiles de Archosauria.

facts.statement: Bagualosaurus is classified in a derived position within Sauropodomorpha, placed below Pantydraco and above the clade containing Chromogisaurus and Saturnalia.
facts.quote: Bagualosaurus se colocó en una posición derivada libremente en el Sauropodomorpha en relación con la alta edad geológica, bajo Pantydraco y por encima de un clado formado por Chromogisaurus y Saturnalia.

facts.statement: While retaining powerful hind legs suited for running, the animal shows clear adaptations for a herbivorous lifestyle in its smaller skull and teeth.
facts.quote: Bagualosaurus aún tiene las poderosas patas traseras, adecuadas para correr rápido, pero muestra claras adaptaciones a una forma de vida herbívora en los dientes y el cráneo más pequeño.

facts.statement: The genus lived from the Carnian to the Norian stages, between 237 and 205.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Norian (237 to 205.7 million years ago)

facts.statement: Bagualosaurus was the largest known sauropodomorph of the Carnian period, before later sauropodomorphs gradually increased in size.
facts.quote: Más tarde Sauropodomorpha aumentaría gradualmente en tamaño.

facts.statement: The animal likely had a mixed diet or shifted to herbivory, indicated by its powerful legs for speed alongside smaller skull and teeth adaptations for plant eating.
facts.quote: Bagualosaurus aún tiene las poderosas patas traseras, adecuadas para correr rápido, pero muestra claras adaptaciones a una forma de vida herbívora en los dientes y el cráneo más pequeño.
